page.content:
Innocent knight who first sees the Grail procession.

How Perceval connects

  • Event: Grail Quest — Perceval is one of the three who see the Grail.
  • Faction: Round Table — Perceval rides from the Table toward the Grail.

What is Perceval?

Perceval, the Welsh Peredur grown into French romance, fails to ask the healing question at the Fisher King's court and later joins the Grail quest that Galahad finishes.

Key threads lead to Grail Quest and Round Table.
